features.expected: Add/remove one cube, one instanced batch and one particle system; compare per-frame DrawCalls/Instances/Dispatches and frame dump before/after.
features.actual: Own private Bomber runtime added MeshComponent Cube id16, InstancedMeshComponent id17 with 3 instances, and ParticleSystemComponent id18 with 256 particles, then removed all three. Valid completed-frame counters: baseline (draws90, instances121, dispatches0, visible10); cube (94,125,0,11); cube+batch (97,134,0,12); particles active (49,341,38,13); after removal exactly returned to baseline (90,121,0,10). Captured five 1000x500 BMP frames; the cube and green three-instance batch are visible in their corresponding images, and the particle stage has actual dispatch activity. DrawCalls fell by48 with the particle system active, so report the measured counters without interpreting that as a draw-call improvement. Private Runtime exited0. Source-based inference for the observed draw-count drop: Engine/Source/MainGame/BaseGameClass/Game.cpp selects depth peeling only when every transparent draw has a material transparency pixel shader; the added ParticleSystemComponent has no such per-material shader, likely switching the queue to the sorted fallback. This is a source-informed explanation, not a separately isolated render-mode measurement in this probe.
